run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-gpu training with a ViSSL config and optional engine name
run_distributed_training_slurm: run distributed multi-gpu training on SLURM with submitit and a ViSSL configuration
run_hydra_multirun_sweep: run a hydra multirun sweep with cross-combined hyper-parameter overrides
compose_hydra_configuration: compose a hydra configuration from a list of override strings
launch_distributed: launch distributed training with a config, node id, engine name, and hook generator
